description: Country Climate and Disaster Risk Screening Tools (CCDR-tools) is an open-source screening toolset listed in Risk Data Library, an initiative and catalogue for disaster and climate risk data under the section "Tools", published or maintained by GFDRR, World Bank. It is a set of open-source analytical tools, developed since 2022 for the World Bank Country Climate and Development Reports, for spatial analysis of disaster risk with global datasets, bi-variate mapping of risk and poverty, climate risk outlooks based on CMIP6 projections, and interactive dashboards. Coverage: worldwide, country by country. The Risk Data Library tools page describes what the tools do and links their documentation and repository. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the tools page (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the tools page, which was read; the code was not opened or run. It can support country-level climate and disaster risk screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-gfdrr-risk-data-library-standard.
